specs.title: fills the password field before a locator assertion fails

error.message:
Error: expect(locator).toHaveValue(expected) failed

Locator:  locator('#password')
Expected: "this-will-never-match"
Received: "SSE_FAKE_PASSWORD_VALUE"
Timeout:  1000ms

Call log:
  - Expect "toHaveValue" with timeout 1000ms
  - waiting for locator('#password')
    - unexpected value "SSE_FAKE_PASSWORD_VALUE"
